headline: Alabama constitutional right to bear arms strengthened, by 72%-28% vote
snippet: Most protective legal standard applied to any gun regulation challenge.

headline: Alabama Right to Bear Arms, Amendment 3 (2014)
snippet: Voters approved 72%-28% to declare right to bear arms fundamental right subject to strict scrutiny.

headline: Alabama Voters Approve Gun Rights Amendment
snippet: Amendment also barred international treaties from limiting gun rights.
